content.text: gait problems may be treated w extended-release 4-aminopyridine (dalfampridine).
Dalfampridine ER (Ampyra) dose, walking in multiple sclerosis:

10 mg ER tablet PO twice daily, ~12 h apart; do not exceed. No added benefit >10 mg twice daily; adverse reactions incl seizures more frequent at higher doses. Take w or w/o food; administer tablets whole — do not divide, crush, chew, or dissolve. Missed dose: do not take double or extra doses. Estimate CrCl b4 initiating and monitor at least annually during tx.
history of seizure. CI: moderate or severe renal impairment (CrCl≤50 mL/min). CI: Hx of hypersensitivity to AMPYRA or 4-aminopyridine (incl anaphylaxis).

Seizures: permanently discontinue and do not restart if a seizure occurs on tx. Mild renal impairment (CrCl 51–80 mL/min): plasma levels may approach those at 15 mg twice daily, ↑ seizure risk — weigh benefit vs risk. ⍉ concomitant other forms of 4-aminopyridine (4-AP, fampridine) — same active ingredient. Anaphylaxis/severe allergic reactions: respiratory compromise, urticaria, angioedema of throat/tongue; instruct pts to discontinue and seek immediate medical care if these occur.

OCT2 inhibitors (e.g., cimetidine) may ↑ dalfampridine exposure; elevated levels ↑ seizure risk; weigh benefit of concurrent OCT2 inhibitors vs seizure risk. OD: seizure, confusion, tremulousness, diaphoresis, amnesia; some develop status epilepticus responsive to standard seizure therapy.
